description: A failing close over an empty file: the shortest error path in the program, and the one that proves the close is unconditional. app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:83 performs 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE immediately after the loop at :74-81, whatever the loop did, so a file that yielded no record still gets closed and a close failure still abends. Four lines out: the start banner, then 'ERROR CLOSING CARDFILE', the image '9000' and 'ABENDING PROGRAM'. No record line, because the first READ reported '10'; no end banner, because :85 is past the abend. RETURN-CODE 12.
